evidence.quote: the sharp temporary increases in some categories of goods and services seem unlikely to leave an imprint on longer-run inflation behavior.
That said, today employment remains far from our goal.
Just as it is important to be attentive to upside risks, it is also important to be attentive to the risks of pulling back too soon.

Remaining steady in our outcomes-based approach during the transitory reopening surge will help ensure the economic momentum that will be needed as current tailwinds shift to headwinds is not curtailed by a premature tightening of financial conditions.
This type of environment creates asymmetric risks, since the lower bound constraint means that policy can respond more readily when inflation surprises to the upside than to the downside.

parsed.rationale: Brainard views the inflation pickup as transitory and stresses that employment remains far from goal. She warns against premature tightening, signaling continued accommodation despite some acknowledgment of upside inflation risk.
